name: Ice roller

lead: An ice roller is a handheld roller with a chilled head, either a frozen gel or a metal cylinder, that is rolled over the face. It is used in short sessions to reduce morning puffiness and calm skin.
It is mainly a morning-of-event tool for a fresher, less swollen look.

paras: Cold causes local vasoconstriction, reducing blood flow and fluid leakage into tissue, which lessens puffiness and redness for a short time. The effect fades as the skin rewarms.

Risks are minimal if skin is not frozen for long; avoid direct prolonged contact, and people with cold urticaria, Raynaud's or sensitivity to cold should be careful. I found no trial of cold rollers on everyday facial puffiness; the closest evidence is on cold-induced vasoconstriction and post-surgical swelling, so the benefit is plausible but only short-lived.
